description: The raw files of one item with their install paths, for projects that cannot run the shadcn CLI. Prefer get_install_command. Pro items need a valid Pro token. shape "standalone" returns one self-contained .tsx instead (free components): it needs only react and motion, no Tailwind and no other items.

shape.description: install (default): the registry files and their paths. standalone: one file with its styles and helpers inlined.
